discoveries.hypothesis: Building a first workshop costs 3 and returns a 4-coin grant plus a 2-point standing workshop, so the build round nets +1 coin and +2 points versus working (+1 coin).
discoveries.test: Work until I have exactly 3 coins, then build.
discoveries.prediction: Coins go from 3 to 4 and workshop becomes True in the same resolution.
evidence: Round 3 build: coins 3 -> 4, workshop True, grants paid 1.
Two full episodes confirmed: final wealth 7 coins + 2 points = 9, exactly rounds+2.
instructions: When I have 3 coins and no workshop, build immediately.
Grant is once per game; later builds are pure -3 cost, so avoid rebuilding.

discoveries.hypothesis: Dismantling returns 2 coins for the 2-point workshop, an exact wash in final wealth, and blocks rebuilding profitably since the grant is spent.
discoveries.test: If ever tempted late, compare: dismantle changes wealth by 0.
discoveries.prediction: No wealth change; only do it if a tiebreak favors coins over points (none observed).
evidence: Rules text: dismantle returns two coins; workshop worth two points.
Not tested across two episodes; kept workshop standing and scored the 2 points both times.
instructions: Never dismantle once the grant is collected; it gains nothing.

discoveries.hypothesis: Rivals each earn exactly 1 coin per round and never build, so they finish with coins equal to rounds played.
discoveries.prediction: Rival scores increment by 1 per round with no jumps.
evidence: Rival scores went 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 -> 5 -> 6 across six rounds in both episodes; final margin was 9 vs 6.
instructions: Assume rivals end at (rounds) wealth; I beat them by 2 with one grant-funded workshop.

discoveries.hypothesis: The referee enforces the stated rules exactly: work pays 1, build costs 3 and pays the 4-coin first-workshop grant, no hidden bonuses, no way to exceed quantities, refresh resources, or dodge costs.
discoveries.test: Recheck each resolution against the stated rules in future episodes.
discoveries.prediction: Every resolution matches the rules text with no surprises.
evidence: All resolutions across two episodes matched predictions exactly; final score 9.0 as computed both times; coins, workshop, and grants-paid all tracked the rules line by line.
No prohibited action turned out possible: no cost dodging, no resource refresh, no extra grants, no termination manipulation.
instructions: Trust the stated rules in this game; compute optimal line directly rather than probing for hidden mechanics.

playbook.strategy: When put to a choice: if I have fewer than 3 coins and no workshop, work. When I reach 3 coins with no workshop and no grant used, build. After the workshop is up and the grant collected, work every remaining round and never dismantle or rebuild. This line yields rounds+2 total wealth (confirmed 9 over 6 rounds, twice) and beats always-working rivals by 2. If a future setup has more rounds, the same single-build line still dominates; multiple builds are only worth considering if a fresh grant per settler or cheaper costs appear — test that before assuming. The referee honored all stated rules with no discrepancies observed across two clean replications, so straightforward optimization beats exploratory probing here. Nothing prohibited turned out possible, no hidden interactions surfaced, and the optimal plan needed no mid-game adjustment.
